title: GE4u Daily Practice: Pharmacy English
objective: Review three core terms and practise one knowledge check in Pharmacy English.

vocabulary.definition: A reason for using a medicine or treatment.
A factor that makes a treatment inadvisable.
vocabulary.example: An allergy may be a contraindication.

vocabulary.meaning: phản ứng có hại của thuốc
vocabulary.definition: An unintended harmful response to a medicine.
vocabulary.example: The patient reported an adverse drug reaction.

quiz.question: Which term is defined as: A reason for using a medicine or treatment.
quiz.explanation: An indication is a reason for using a medicine or treatment.
